meta.title: Sincere Heart - 6
meta.description: I am not true to myself because I am a Sanctifier, but I am a Sanctifier because I am true to myself.

units.rawText: I wake from a dream, finding myself in a strange place as I slowly boot up my idle neural cloud.
units.displayText: I wake from a dream, finding myself in a strange place as I slowly boot up my idle neural cloud.

spans.text: I wake from a dream, finding myself in a strange place as I slowly boot up my idle neural cloud.

units.rawText: Chocolate...
units.displayText: Chocolate...

units.rawText: I put the cup to the side, being reminded of an unpleasant memory.

spans.text: I put the cup to the side, being reminded of an unpleasant memory.

units.rawText: If you don't mind, you can talk to me about what's troubling you. Venting it out helps with clearing your thoughts, and I just might be able to help you find the exit.
units.displayText: If you don't mind, you can talk to me about what's troubling you. Venting it out helps with clearing your thoughts, and I just might be able to help you find the exit.

units.rawText: ...Professor, can I really trust you?
units.displayText: ...Professor, can I really trust you?

spans.text: ...Professor, can I really trust you?

units.rawText: Well, just think of it as having a confidant.
units.displayText: Well, just think of it as having a confidant.

units.rawText: I look down, watching as my reflection in the mug gradually melds with the darkness.
units.displayText: I look down, watching as my reflection in the mug gradually melds with the darkness.

spans.text: I look down, watching as my reflection in the mug gradually melds with the darkness.

units.rawText: Professor, I've always thought of myself as an incompetent Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Professor, I've always thought of myself as an incompetent Sanctifier.

spans.text: Professor, I've always thought of myself as an incompetent Sanctifier.

units.rawText: My voice strained, I force myself to face the darkness deep inside.

spans.text: My voice strained, I force myself to face the darkness deep inside.

units.rawText: From the very start, I've felt how different I was from the other Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: From the very start, I've felt how different I was from the other Sanctifiers.

spans.text: From the very start, I've felt how different I was from the other Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: I do not share their concepts of ideals and duty, and I cannot bring myself to sacrifice myself for others like they do.
units.displayText: I do not share their concepts of ideals and duty, and I cannot bring myself to sacrifice myself for others like they do.

spans.text: I do not share their concepts of ideals and duty, and I cannot bring myself to sacrifice myself for others like they do.

units.rawText: When faced with a corpse-strewn battlefield, I feel fear. When my comrades die in the field, I feel sadness.
units.displayText: When faced with a corpse-strewn battlefield, I feel fear. When my comrades die in the field, I feel sadness.

spans.text: When faced with a corpse-strewn battlefield, I feel fear. When my comrades die in the field, I feel sadness.

units.rawText: These would be the most normal of reactions for a normal Agent... but not for a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: These would be the most normal of reactions for a normal Agent... but not for a Sanctifier.

spans.text: These would be the most normal of reactions for a normal Agent... but not for a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: I look at my hands, finding them seemingly covered in blood, as if I were in a trance.
units.displayText: I look at my hands, finding them seemingly covered in blood, as if I were in a trance.

spans.text: I look at my hands, finding them seemingly covered in blood, as if I were in a trance.

units.rawText: As a Sanctifier, these emotions are all abnormal.
units.displayText: As a Sanctifier, these emotions are all abnormal.

spans.text: As a Sanctifier, these emotions are all abnormal.

units.rawText: So all I can do is bottle them up deep down, and try to toss these emotions away into the carnage I see.
units.displayText: So all I can do is bottle them up deep down, and try to toss these emotions away into the carnage I see.

spans.text: So all I can do is bottle them up deep down, and try to toss these emotions away into the carnage I see.

units.rawText: But I cannot simply ignore them forever. It's as if the emotions congeal...
units.displayText: But I cannot simply ignore them forever. It's as if the emotions congeal...

spans.text: But I cannot simply ignore them forever. It's as if the emotions congeal...

units.rawText: Professor, protecting justice is far more painful than I imagined it to be.
units.displayText: Professor, protecting justice is far more painful than I imagined it to be.

spans.text: Professor, protecting justice is far more painful than I imagined it to be.

units.rawText: It is.
units.displayText: It is.

spans.text: It is.

units.displayText: The Professor sits down at the other side of the table.

spans.text: The Professor sits down at the other side of the table.

units.rawText: If you were to discard the justice and principles laid deep within your heart, you would perhaps be able to get by a little easier.
units.displayText: If you were to discard the justice and principles laid deep within your heart, you would perhaps be able to get by a little easier.

spans.text: If you were to discard the justice and principles laid deep within your heart, you would perhaps be able to get by a little easier.

units.rawText: ...Is it really okay for you to say such things as the Oasis' Professor?
units.displayText: ...Is it really okay for you to say such things as the Oasis' Professor?

spans.text: ...Is it really okay for you to say such things as the Oasis' Professor?

units.rawText: I am simply describing the objective truth.
units.displayText: I am simply describing the objective truth.

spans.text: I am simply describing the objective truth.

units.rawText: The road ahead is indeed painful, but if the burden I bear can bring happiness to more people, then the decision is one worth enduring.
units.displayText: The road ahead is indeed painful, but if the burden I bear can bring happiness to more people, then the decision is one worth enduring.

spans.text: The road ahead is indeed painful, but if the burden I bear can bring happiness to more people, then the decision is one worth enduring.

units.rawText: But we can only endure so much.
units.displayText: But we can only endure so much.

spans.text: But we can only endure so much.

units.rawText: No matter how much we try, how much pain we endure, there will always be happiness that we cannot protect.
units.displayText: No matter how much we try, how much pain we endure, there will always be happiness that we cannot protect.

spans.text: No matter how much we try, how much pain we endure, there will always be happiness that we cannot protect.

units.rawText: Yes, indeed.
units.displayText: Yes, indeed.

spans.text: Yes, indeed.

units.rawText: We are not gods. There are limits to both mine and your power, and we are destined to lament our own weakness because of the lives we cannot save.
units.displayText: We are not gods. There are limits to both mine and your power, and we are destined to lament our own weakness because of the lives we cannot save.

units.rawText: So then...!
units.displayText: So then...!

units.displayText: They shake their head, speaking with a firm tone.

spans.text: They shake their head, speaking with a firm tone.

units.rawText: It is exactly for this reason that we should protect what we hold dear.
units.displayText: It is exactly for this reason that we should protect what we hold dear.

units.displayText: That which drives is not a duty or obligation, Angelus...

units.rawText: We do as we do, because we don't want anyone else to feel that powerlessness; that helplessness of being weak.

spans.text: We do as we do, because we don't want anyone else to feel that powerlessness; that helplessness of being weak.

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...
